cases.name: Crystal Ann Holderman
cases.about: (aka Crystal Fetch) Her obituary said, "Crystal was a homemaker and mother.  She loved the outdoors and was a great fisher.  She loved to teach her nieces and nephews to fish. She liked to garden, craft, and cook."
cases.narrative: Police found her in the master bedroom. He allegedly shot her in the left eye with an AR-15. The Meade County Sheriff’s Department said the (911) caller told dispatch that “Dad’s gun went off. Mother has been shot.”
